title: 76쪽 · 3x LJ Open — BB Defense
sourcePageBasis: capture sequence, checked against surrounding folios
paragraphs: 3-betting light is a much less viable option against early and middle position opens. Early position openers have to deal with so many players behind them — players who can wake up with a hand and 3-bet, or flat and force the opener to play three streets out of position — that they have no choice but to tighten their opening ranges. Consequently, it’s difficult to generate fold equity by 3-betting light against their value-centric ranges.
